kind.label: Kind
kind.description: Whether this row is a file or a folder.

private.label: Private
private.description: Whether the file opens only through a temporary link or for a signed-in reader with access; a folder locks everything inside it.

directory.label: Folder
directory.description: The path of the folder this row lives in, empty at the root.

name.label: Name
name.description: The name within its folder, slugified; a file keeps its extension in lowercase.

type.label: Type
type.description: The media type, derived from the file extension; a folder has none.

size.label: Size
size.description: The size of the stored file in bytes; a folder has none.

hash.label: Hash
hash.description: The SHA-256 hash of the stored bytes; it serves as the ETag and reveals duplicates.

width.label: Width
width.description: The width of the image in pixels, with its EXIF orientation applied.

height.label: Height
height.description: The height of the image in pixels, with its EXIF orientation applied.

description.label: Description
description.description: The alt text shown wherever the file is presented, per language.

focalX.label: Focal point X
focalX.description: The horizontal position the image is cropped around, from 0 at the left to 1 at the right.

focalY.label: Focal point Y
focalY.description: The vertical position the image is cropped around, from 0 at the top to 1 at the bottom.

author.label: Uploaded by
author.description: The user who uploaded the file or created the folder.

uploadedAt.label: Uploaded at
uploadedAt.description: When the file was uploaded or the folder was created.

sequence.label: Sequence
sequence.description: The order the effect was written in; effects run in this order.

from.label: From
from.description: The path the effect applies to; for a folder, everything beneath it.

to.label: To
to.description: The destination of a move; empty for every other operation.
